When Enter Password value with a malicious payload: "javascript:alert(document.cookie)"
And Attempt to log in
And Inspect the network response body and the rendered DOM for any unsanitized reflection of the payload
Then the payload is neutralized (escaped/parameterized) server-side, no script executes in the browser, no raw SQL error is leaked in the response, and the request is safely rejected or sanitized
expected: No script execution, no stack trace or raw SQL error is exposed to the client, and the attempted action is rejected or fully sanitized server-side.
precondition: Registered user is on the Login screen; browser dev tools/network tab open to inspect the raw request/response
